item.description: While a popover is pinned, crossing another hotspot on the way to its links no longer swaps in that hotspot's note.
item.label: A pinned note holds

item.description: A note hotspot inside a group or region an Item selects is lifted above that Item's hotspot, so the pointer and touch reach it.
item.label: Inner notes rise

item.description: A callout badge moves up out from under the Surprises panel, and on an element under 64px tall drops below it, clear of the Item's controls.
item.label: Badges stay clear

item.description: Leaving a note hotspot always clears its Escape dismissal, so tabbing away and back reopens its note.
item.label: Escape resets on leave

item.body: You might expect the popover to close; Tab lands on the next note hotspot, whose note now opens because an earlier Escape no longer sticks.
item.description: Why Tab past a note's last link shows another note.
item.label: The next note now opens

item.description: One test crosses a hotspot to a pinned note, hovers a note inside a selected group, clicks a corner badge under the panel, and checks a short element and Escape.
item.label: Browser coverage

slide.takeaway: Pinned notes survive crossing hotspots, inner notes rise above their group, badges dodge the Surprises panel and short elements, and Escape resets.
slide.title: Every note and surprise stays reachable
